'''Crystal Valley''' was a [[City/Legends|town]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. It contained a [[Water/Legends|water]] pumping station that fed water to the town from underground. In [[44 ABY]] the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] used Crystal Valley as a location to hide as she took over the [[Theran Listener]]s. Part of a [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] between Abeloth and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] later took part there.
